inspectionOrder: Brief parsed excluding qualityCriteria; actual original, target, family reference and native collection inspected before any reviews or judge criteria.

visualObservations.original: Quarter-annular dark blue moving deck with salmon rails and wooden supports. Broad flat rail treatment and very dark legs leave weak construction and limited warm material cues.
visualObservations.target: Thicker-looking crafted peach rail with soft bright shoulder, rounded wood supports, small brass fittings and softly varied blue deck. Corner identity remains clear. Target painted caps/highlight framing cannot establish connector geometry.
visualObservations.family: Approved family reference has narrow peach rail shoulder accents, blue deck grooves and honey legs with restrained brass pins. Corner cross-section must remain compatible.

nativeObservations.orientation: Unlike family straight intrinsic pi. Published root facing rotations N180 E90 S0 W-90.
nativeObservations.deck: 98 vertices, 48 quad angular strips, source curved UV.x samples start 0,0.016638... and end1; source angular mapping retained rather than linear straight UV. Single shader Value action 25 keys.
nativeObservations.railEnvelope: inner radial .02..15, outer .85..98 around (.5,.5), z .505..695; deck z .64. Open connection profiles must be preserved.
nativeObservations.support: Quarter-annular support and four separately rotated legs; source inspection world matrices require dependency graph evaluation before final bounds.
nativeObservations.camera: Use per-object source-camera plus approved family settings, not saved active scene.

implementationIntent: Rebuild curved native rails with equivalent cross-section coordinate basis and invariant longitudinal shoulder field.
Retain deck mesh/curved UV and original action while transferring approved family shader basis.
Improve wood support bevels, honey material, subtle foot cuffs and tiny brass structural pins within clearance.
Publish 96 unique frames plus separate closure; native/capture/consumer evidence and portable replay.
